material.description: CDC разделы «Boil» и «Steps for boiling water»; ограничение для химического и радиоактивного загрязнения приведено на той же странице в разделе «Water with fuel or toxic chemicals in it».
material.locator: CDC page: section “Boil” and “Steps for boiling water”; read together with “Water with fuel or toxic chemicals in it” because boiling is microbial treatment, not chemical/radioactive remediation.
